note: COMPLETE THE CELL — box every symbol the detector reads, in ONE pass. The model has pre-labelled: confirm with `t`, reject with `f`, fix a class with `c`, redraw a box with `b`. Then add what it MISSED with the number keys below. This is a triage pass, not a draw-from-scratch one, so most cells should be fast. BOX: noteheads (hollow and black), rests, accidentals, clefs, dynamics, slurs, ties, hairpins, augmentation dots, articulations, time signatures. SKIP: staff lines, stems and beams (classical CV finds those, and YOLO cannot bbox a thin line), and free text like `sempre`, `dolce`, tempo marks and instrument names — a letter lifted out of a printed word must train as BACKGROUND, so reject those with `f`. KEY-SIG accidentals stay separate from inline ones. Tab out of a swept cell even if you changed nothing: that stamps the pass and IS the coverage record.
